# Pillar RSK03: Downside-upside beta asymmetry (one-sided)
Definition: Beta to the world reference in down months minus beta in up months over 120 months, point-in-time. One-sided against VWRA: only asymmetry above VWRA's is penalised, with k = 0.2, and lower asymmetry earns nothing above 50. Weight 0.35 of RSK.
Source: yfinance .L and proxy monthly returns (verified). Better when: lower (one-sided). Informs: portfolio_mix.
Week 2026-W46.
